title: Fish Audio Releases Drama 3, a 35B Open-Weight MoE Text-to-Speech Model
summary: Fish Audio released Drama 3, a 35B mixture-of-experts text-to-speech model with about 3B active parameters. It takes plain-language direction, covers 83 languages and ships open weights under a revenue-capped community license. The post Fish Audio Releases Drama 3, a 35B Open-Weight MoE Text-to-Speech Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
